# M3 live run index

Each directory holds the run's `llm_trace.jsonl` (every LLM call: campaign turns and inner-architect calls; key-redacted in code and scanned again by `scripts/archive_traces_m3.py`). Structured runs add `report.md` and `evaluations.csv.gz`; campaign runs add `tool_log.jsonl` (every tool call with its answer) and `dse/` with each inner `run_dse` call's report and evaluations. Summary JSONs: `eval/data/agent_m3/`, `campaign_m3/`, `campaign_m3_memory/`, `m3_pilot/`. Provider-reported cost of these runs: $3.4519.
